prompt: An evacuated chamber contains two vertical parallel plates connected to a power supply through a switch that is initially closed. A positive charge falls under gravity from a point near the top, between the plates. While the switch is closed the charge follows a path that curves towards one plate. When the charge has fallen halfway down, the switch is opened (disconnecting the plates from the supply but leaving them charged). Which best describes the rest of the trajectory?
options: It keeps curving towards the same plate, because the isolated plates retain their charge and the field between them is unchanged
It becomes a straight line, because opening the switch removes the field
It curves back towards the other plate
It falls straight down, because gravity is now the only force
answer: It keeps curving towards the same plate, because the isolated plates retain their charge and the field between them is unchanged
hint: An isolated (disconnected) charged capacitor holds its charge, so its field does not change.
